subject.title: feat: expose resolved backend model in session_status and agent runtime

question: What canonical contract should OpenClaw expose for selected versus effective versus actual upstream model identity across session rows and `session_status`?
rationale: The issue crosses Gateway API shape, persisted session metadata, provider fallback, and user-visible status wording, while current fields already carry related but ambiguous runtime state.

options.title: Add explicit resolved-runtime fields
options.body: Additive `resolvedProvider`/`resolvedModel`/`fallbackUsed` style fields can preserve existing selected-model behavior while exposing the actual backend identity.

options.title: Clarify existing model fields only
options.body: Treat current `modelProvider/model` as the effective runtime identity and update status text or docs without adding a new Gateway contract.

options.title: Split by consumer surface
options.body: Keep proxy/backend observability in provider diagnostics and leave UI/status follow-ups to narrower linked issues.

recommendation.title: Add explicit resolved-runtime fields
recommendation.body: Additive `resolvedProvider`/`resolvedModel`/`fallbackUsed` style fields can preserve existing selected-model behavior while exposing the actual backend identity.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest local history signal ties this person to the current model attribution and session/status surfaces that need the contract decision.
